title: Session launching and tracking
summary: Wave 1 design foundation nearing completion. Session system design now makes SDK launch preparation, Copilot CLI worker launch, and observation-based tracking explicit.

nodes.title: Bootstrap design docs
nodes.summary: Create Streamliner's repo-scoped docs/design set from the current root docs and switch this workstream to reference that design layer.

nodes.title: Make workstream design explicit
nodes.summary: Run explicit design sessions for the full workstream so the launch contract, key design decisions, and downstream issue-graph adjustments are written down before more implementation issues are finalized.

nodes.title: Wave 1: design foundation aligned
nodes.summary: Repo-scoped design docs exist and the workstream's explicit design direction is clear enough to guide implementation without relying on implicit brief-or-graph assumptions.

nodes.title: Backend context assembly
nodes.summary: Assemble the Layer 0-3 launch payload inputs on the backend per the session system design: read design docs, extract brief sections, and resolve node specs so the SDK launch-prep step can write the context files after paw-init creates the PAW work directory.

nodes.title: Copilot SDK launch prep plumbing
nodes.summary: Use Copilot SDK on the backend to gather context, run paw-init in the target repo, write context files, and return the launch spec before the Copilot CLI worker session starts.

nodes.title: Launch claim binding
nodes.summary: Record launch claims before terminal startup and bind discovered sessions using a launch nonce plus cwd/branch/window guardrails so the visible Copilot CLI session attaches to the correct graph node.

nodes.title: Terminal launch integration
nodes.summary: Launch a visible Copilot CLI interactive session from the graph with the prepared kickoff prompt so the operator can watch and intervene in the PAW session as needed.

nodes.title: Session state observation
nodes.summary: Extend initial launch-claim binding into the full observation-based session tracking model: watch Copilot session state files, detect turn boundaries from events.jsonl, process hook signal files, derive idle/needs-input state, and read PAW `## Control State` (including `Workflow Identity`) from `WorkflowContext.md` / `ReviewContext.md` as the workflow progression source (with legacy artifact inference as fallback).

nodes.title: Runtime overlay in UI
nodes.summary: Overlay live observed session state and tracker snapshots onto the committed graph in the UI, combining committed node status with runtime session status per the overlay model in the session system design.

nodes.title: Launch and tracking usable
nodes.summary: A node can launch a PAW session into a visible terminal and Streamliner can show live runtime state for that node without committing telemetry into the workstream artifacts.

checkpoints.title: Design foundation aligned
checkpoints.summary: Repo-scoped design docs exist and the workstream's explicit design direction is captured.

checkpoints.title: Launch from graph works
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner assembles context, runs paw-init, establishes launch-claim support, compiles the kickoff prompt, and launches a visible Copilot CLI interactive session from a node.

checkpoints.title: Tracking visible in UI
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner overlays runtime session and tracker state on the graph without turning graph.json into a telemetry log.
